description:
Creates a DNS record

HTTP: POST /v1/dns/zones/:domain_id/records
Category: DNS
Required scopes: dns:write
Returns: {status, data: object {id, zone_id, type, name, content, ttl, priority, weight, port, auth, external_record_id, disabled, … (+4 more)}}
Mutating: changes server state.

content.description: Record value: IPv4 for A, IPv6 for AAAA, target host for CNAME/MX/NS/SRV, text for TXT; private/reserved IPs are rejected for A/AAAA (required unless value i…

name.description: Host name relative to the zone, e.g

priority.description: For MX and SRV records; ignored for other types

type.description: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, PTR, SRV, TXT, CAA, TLSA, DS

domain_id.description: UUID of the domain — obtain it from GET /v1/domains
